corrections.reason: The skill asks kids to sort habits such as too much screen time, smoking, and vaping, and to pick ways to encourage healthier choices. A kid can learn these without first learning that mind is part of health (g1-hlth-mental-health). The link to mental health is indirect, so the prerequisite is not truly needed and should be removed.

output.notes: Checked all 14 Grade 1 skills for needed, direct, non-circular prerequisites, and for missing same-grade prerequisites. Every other skill's prerequisites are needed and direct, and no skill lists a redundant transitive prerequisite. Titles and descriptions are appropriate for read-aloud. One judgment call was left unchanged: g1-hlth-caring-behaviours mentions unsafe touching and consent but does not require g1-hlth-body-parts, since a kid can recognize harmful behaviour without using correct anatomical terms. The reviewer may want to reconsider this if the curriculum intends naming body parts as groundwork for discussing inappropriate touching.
